key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:07FC
name: append_trailing_slash_if_flagged
description: Walks to the end of the path string in the buffer and appends a slash and terminator when a flag in the state record is clear; when the flag is set it calls another routine instead.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:080E
name: append_slash_to_path_end
description: Walks to the terminating zero of the path buffer, then writes a slash and a new terminator after it. Used to turn a directory name into a path prefix.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:0826
name: copy_string_from_record_field
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from the pointer stored in a state-record field into the destination buffer, including the terminator. It has three callers.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:099E
name: prompt_overwrite_with_cached_answer
description: Returns a cached per-file overwrite decision when one exists; otherwise it reads a single response character and maps the answers Yes, No, Quit, Skip and All to a return value. The chosen answer is stored for later files.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1140
name: test_whitespace_character
description: Returns 1 when the character in the data register is a space, tab, newline or carriage return, and 0 otherwise.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:11E4
name: parse_lha_command_line
description: Parses the LhA command line and the optional LHAOPTS environment variable into command letters, options and file names. It handles quoted strings and include files, and reports illegal commands and unterminated quotes.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:16EC
name: parse_decimal_digit
description: Returns the numeric value of a decimal digit character and advances the parse position past it. For any other character it returns 1 and leaves the position unchanged.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:18B0
name: parse_lha_option_letters
description: Reads option letters from the LhA command line and sets the matching state fields, including task priority, multivolume size and header options. It reports invalid option, extended option and priority errors through the output routines.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1B88
name: resolve_lha_default_options
description: Fills in default option values for the command letter and the interactive state of the input, and checks the header level is between 0 and 2. An out-of-range level is reported and reset to 0.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1CC0
name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: A thin wrapper that calls one other routine with no arguments and returns. It contains no logic of its own.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1CC8
name: close_open_files_and_locks
description: Closes every file in the file-handle table and unlocks the directory locks, restoring the current directory through dos calls. It is the cleanup step before the program exits.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1F08
name: open_file_into_handle_table
description: Opens a file through the dos library and stores the handle in the first free slot of a 10-entry table. Returns 0 when the table is full.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1F4E
name: close_file_from_handle_table
description: Finds a handle in the 10-entry file table, closes it through the dos library and clears that slot.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1F8E
name: lock_path_into_lock_table
description: Locks a file or directory through the dos library and stores the lock in the first free slot of a 64-entry table. Returns 0 when the table is full.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1FD4
name: register_lock_handle
description: Stores the value in the data register in the first free slot of the 64-entry lock table. It does not call the dos library.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1FE2
name: store_into_free_lock_slot
description: Stores the value in the data register in the first free slot of the 64-entry lock table, scanning from the index in the next register. It returns nothing and does not call the dos library.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1FFA
name: store_lock_at_index
description: Stores the value in the data register into the lock table slot at the index held in another register. It is a single store with no search.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:200E
name: unlock_and_clear_lock_entry
description: Searches the 64-entry lock table for the matching handle, clears its slot and releases the lock through the dos library.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2052
name: build_lha_temp_filename
description: Builds a temporary file name from the LhATmp prefix followed by a string copied from the state record, then calls two helper routines to finish it.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:228A
name: allocate_file_spec_record
description: Finds a free slot in the 10-entry file table and creates a file-specification record there, filling in its mode flags from the option letter. Fragment of a larger decode, so the surrounding flow is only partly recovered.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:22A0
name: allocate_file_spec_alternate
description: Alternate entry into the file-spec allocation: same slot search and option-letter flag setting, using a different register for the option letter. Partly recovered from the decode.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:22CC
name: configure_file_spec_flags
description: Continues file-spec setup: sets mode flags from the option letter, and opens or locks the file when the write or read options apply. Partly recovered from the decode.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:22DE
name: set_file_spec_mode_flags
description: Applies the option letter to a file-spec record as mode flags, then reads the next option state. Partly recovered from the decode.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2308
name: initialize_file_spec_fields
description: Sets the default size, position and status fields of a new file-spec record and handles the write-mode options. Partly recovered from the decode.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2354
name: finish_file_spec_setup
description: Completes file-spec setup for an option: sets the flags and fills in the record fields that depend on whether the file already exists. Partly recovered from the decode.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2370
name: examine_file_for_spec
description: Examines an existing file through dos.Examine when a previous record is present, then sets its mode flags and buffer pointer.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23A0
name: register_file_spec_in_table
description: Sets the mode flags for a file-spec record, allocates its two buffers and stores the record in the 10-entry file table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23D4
name: complete_file_spec_registration
description: Enters the shared tail of file-spec setup: allocates a buffer, stores the buffer pointer in the record and registers the record in the file table. Only the tail is recovered, so the calling flow is inferred.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23D8
name: complete_file_spec_registration_alt
description: Alternate entry into the same shared tail that allocates a buffer and registers a file-spec record in the file table. Only the tail is recovered from the decode.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23DC
name: set_temporary_option_flags_low
description: Sets the lower temporary option bits on a file-spec record and then enters the shared allocation and registration tail. The bits correspond to the lowercase temporary option.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23E6
name: set_temporary_option_flags
description: Sets the upper temporary option bits on a file-spec record and then enters the shared allocation and registration tail. The bits correspond to the uppercase temporary option.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23F0
name: set_file_spec_flag_byte
description: Sets the high bit of the record's flag byte and then enters the shared allocation and registration tail.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23FA
name: finish_file_spec_flag_byte
description: Fragment of the file-spec tail: sets the high bit of the flag byte, then allocates a buffer and registers the record in the file table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2424
name: allocate_file_spec_buffer_tail
description: Fragment of the file-spec tail: clears the buffer pointer, allocates the buffer and stores the record in the file table. Only part of the flow is recovered.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:243E
name: finish_file_spec_registration_fragment
description: Fragment of the file-spec tail: allocates a handle, sets the size and position fields and stores the record in the file table. Only part of the flow is recovered.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2482
name: reset_file_spec_and_register
description: Zeroes the leading fields of a file-spec record, seeks the file when a handle is present, and stores the record in the file table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:24E6
name: close_file_spec_record
description: Releases a file-spec record: deletes the file through dos when it is flagged for removal, closes its handle and clears its slot in the file table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2564
name: seek_buffered_file_position
description: Finds the cached block that contains a file offset in a 128-entry block list. When no cached block matches it seeks the file through dos, and it sets an error flag if the seek fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:261C
name: open_numbered_volume_file
description: Builds an output archive name with a numbered volume suffix and the .lha extension, then opens it. When the file cannot be opened it reports the error, with the wrong-volume hint, and offers the user a quit option.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2736
name: refill_file_read_buffer
description: Refills the input buffer when the read position reaches the end of the current block, allocating a buffer first if none exists. It returns -1 when the buffer or the read fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2764
name: refill_file_read_buffer_alt
description: Alternate form of the input buffer refill: same allocate-then-read sequence and error return, using a different register for the record pointer.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2790
name: refill_buffer_return_length
description: Refills the input buffer when the record has no data left, then returns the new buffer length. It reports dos error codes on failure.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:27C2
name: advance_read_offset_counts
description: Adds the buffered byte count to the file offset, clears the count, and reads the next chunk from the file. It returns the byte count read.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:27E4
name: read_next_file_chunk
description: Adds the buffered byte count to the file offset, reads a chunk through dos.Read, and returns the number of bytes read.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2814
name: flush_file_write_buffer
description: Writes the buffered output through dos.Write when the record is in write mode, and reports the dos error code on failure.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:28FC
name: set_file_position_in_buffer
description: Moves the logical position of a file record for a from-start or from-current seek. It flushes the buffer when the target lies outside the buffered window, and returns -1 for an unsupported seek mode.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2912
name: adjust_file_position_fragment
description: Fragment of the buffered position update: computes the new offset from the window start and reloads the window when the target lies outside it.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2928
name: reposition_buffer_window
description: Moves the buffer window so it contains the target offset, reloading through a helper routine when the offset falls outside the current window.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:292C
name: reposition_buffer_window_offset
description: Variant of the buffer window move that takes the target offset from a different register. It reloads through a helper when the offset lies outside the window.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2932
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes to a single return with no body, so the bytes are not reachable code and no behaviour is recovered.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2936
name: reposition_buffer_window_index
description: Moves the buffer window to the offset in the data register and reloads through a helper when the offset is outside it. Fragment of the window routine.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2954
name: set_buffer_window_start
description: Sets the buffer window start to the requested offset, clears the buffered count and calls a helper to load the window.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2966
name: set_buffer_count_from_offset
description: Sets the buffered byte count to the difference between the requested offset and the window start, then calls a helper.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:29E0
name: copy_bytes_through_file_buffer
description: Copies a requested number of bytes through the file buffer, reloading the window through a helper whenever it runs out. It sets a status flag when no buffer exists and returns the copied total, or -1 on error.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A00
name: copy_bytes_updating_total
description: Copies counted bytes through the file buffer while updating the running total in the caller's frame. It reloads the window through a helper when needed and returns -1 on error.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A14
name: copy_remaining_buffer_bytes
description: Copies the bytes left in the buffer window to the destination, refilling as needed until the requested count is satisfied.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A22
name: copy_buffer_until_empty
description: Loops over the buffer window, copying bytes until the requested count is met or the window is empty, and sets a status flag when the buffer is exhausted.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A30
name: copy_chunks_with_copymem
description: Copies blocks of buffered data to the destination with exec.CopyMem, looping until the buffer window is empty. It returns -1 when a helper reports an error.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A6E
name: copy_chunks_refilling_buffer
description: Copies buffered data in blocks with exec.CopyMem and refills the window through a helper whenever it is exhausted, updating the running counts.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A9C
name: write_bytes_through_file_buffer
description: Writes a requested number of bytes through the file buffer, flushing via a helper when the window fills and marking the buffer as changed. It returns the bytes written, or -1 on error.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2ABC
name: write_bytes_flush_fragment
description: Fragment of the buffered write loop: marks the buffer as changed, flushes through a helper when the window fills and advances the counts. Only part of the flow is recovered.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2AC6
name: write_buffer_loop_continue
description: Continuation of the buffered write loop: flushes the window through a helper, advances the counts and returns -1 when a helper reports an error.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2AD6
name: write_blocks_with_copymem
description: Writes blocks of data into the buffer window with exec.CopyMem and flushes the window through a helper as it fills.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2B20
name: write_blocks_updating_window_end
description: Copies data blocks into the write buffer with exec.CopyMem, extends the window end when a write passes it, and flushes through a helper when the window is full.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2FCE
name: write_byte_to_buffer
description: Stores one byte in the write buffer at the current index and extends the window end. When the buffer is full it flushes through a helper and returns 0, or -1 when the buffer is not writable.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2FF0
name: write_byte_to_buffer_alt
description: Alternate form of the one-byte buffered write, taking the byte from a different register. It has the same flush and window-end handling.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2FFC
name: write_buffer_byte_tail
description: Fragment of the one-byte buffered write: stores the byte, extends the window end and flushes when the buffer is full.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3032
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes to a single return with a three-instruction body of invalid data, so no behaviour is recovered.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:303A
name: read_byte_from_buffer
description: Returns the next byte from the read buffer and advances its index. When no bytes remain it sets an error flag and returns -1.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3052
name: read_next_buffer_byte
description: Returns the byte at the current read index of the buffer and advances the index, with no bounds check.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:30B4
name: run_once_system_setup
description: Queries a system attribute and, when a bit is set, calls two library routines and records that setup has run, so it runs only once.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:30BA
name: shutdown_system_resources
description: Calls a sequence of helper and library routines to release resources, and calls one more routine when a stack flag equals 3.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:30C0
name: forward_to_helper_routine_alt
description: A thin wrapper that calls one other routine and returns. It holds no logic of its own.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F64
name: join_path_components
description: Appends the second string to the first to form a path, inserting a slash unless the first string already ends with a colon or slash. When the first string is empty it copies the second string directly.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F6A
name: unlink_list_node
description: Removes a node from a doubly linked list by joining its neighbours to each other.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F70
name: find_path_separator_end
description: Scans backwards from the end of a string until it reaches a colon or slash, or the start of the string. Fragment of a path-splitting routine.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F7C
name: duplicate_string_copy
description: Measures a string, allocates a buffer of that size through a helper, and copies the string into it when the allocation succeeds.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F82
name: allocate_memory_with_retry
description: Calls the allocator and records the requested size in the block header. When the allocation fails it asks the user whether to retry, and it returns the usable address when a block is obtained.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F88
name: allocate_memory_with_retry_alt
description: Duplicate of the allocation-with-retry routine that also records the requested size and asks the user on failure.

name: report_when_flag_clear_third

name: check_task_flag_alt

name: pause_until_key_pressed_alt
description: Duplicate of the key-wait routine, entered from other callers. It reads one key and checks for Ctrl-C.

name: get_default_stack_size
description: Returns a default stack size of 128 kilobytes, unless the current task has a stack size set, in which case it returns that value.

name: sum_three_helper_results
description: Calls three helper routines and returns the sum of their results.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BABE
name: pack_file_timestamp
description: Splits a date and time into their day, month, year, hour, minute and second fields and packs them into the bit positions of a DOS timestamp word.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BC14
name: pack_dos_date_word
description: Converts a day count into a month and day using a table of month lengths, then packs the year offset from 1980 and the month and day into the bit fields of a DOS date word.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BC3A
name: pack_dos_date_fragment
description: Continuation of the DOS date packing: subtracts month lengths from the day count and writes the month field into the packed word. Only part of the flow is recovered.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BC4C
name: pack_dos_month_day_fragment
description: Continuation of the DOS date packing: writes the month and day fields of the packed word from the remaining day count.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BC76
name: pack_dos_day_fragment
description: Continuation of the DOS date packing: writes the day field of the packed word, using the remaining day count and the month table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BCD0
name: unpack_dos_date_to_days
description: Reads the year, month and day fields from a packed DOS date word, then converts them to a day count by summing month lengths and leap days. The result is stored in the output.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BD5E
name: sum_month_lengths_fragment
description: Adds the length of each month up to the target month to a running total, adding a leap day when the year requires one, then stores the total.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BD9C

name: append_path_component_fragment

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BE0E
name: find_basename_pointer_alt
description: Index-based form of the file-name lookup: scans backwards to the last slash or colon and returns the address of the name that follows.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BE32
name: release_optional_handle_alt
description: Frees a handle through a library routine when its pointer is set, and through a default routine otherwise.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BE4E
name: release_library_or_default
description: Calls a library function through the stored library pointer when one is set, and calls a default routine otherwise.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BE60
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and returns. It holds no logic of its own.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BE6E
name: copy_string_or_dispatch_library
description: Copies a zero-terminated string directly into the destination when no library handle is set. Otherwise it passes the copy to a library routine, and calls a second library routine in the other branch.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BE90
name: copy_string_via_library
description: Copies a zero-terminated string through a library routine when a library pointer is set, and copies it directly otherwise.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BEA2
name: copy_string_loop
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from source to destination byte by byte, including the terminator.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BEB0

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BF9C

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BFA6

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BFE8

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:C00E
